translations.web: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
translations.bsb: but later they changed their minds and took back the menservants and maidservants they had freed, and they forced them to become slaves again.
